name: Energy Melee
description: You can use Energy Melee to power your blows with pure energy. These focused power attacks often Disorient opponents. Total Focus will enter Energy Focus upon hitting an enemy. Barrage, Power Crash or Energy Transfer are empowered while under Energy Focus.

powers.name: Barrage
powers.description: You perform a quick punch that deals moderate damage. Coupled with other energy punches, Barrage can Disorient a foe. This power will have a 100% chance to stun and weaken the target's secondary effects and regeneration rate if used while in Energy Focus mode.

powers.name: Energy Punch
powers.description: You perform a powerful Energy Punch that deals moderate damage. When used with other Energy Melee attacks, Energy Punch can Disorient your opponent.

powers.name: Bone Smasher
powers.description: This melee attack deals a good amount of damage and has a good chance to Disorient the target.

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description: Greatly increases the amount of damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your chance to hit.

powers.name: Whirling Hands
powers.description: By focusing your energy into the muscles in your arms, you can launch a dizzying flurry of attacks against every foe in melee range. Some foes may be hit hard enough to be Disoriented as well.

powers.name: Taunt
powers.description: Taunt foes to attack you. Useful to pull enemies off allies and keep them attacking you to raise your Fury. A To Hit check is required to Taunt enemy players, but is not needed against critter targets.

powers.name: Total Focus
powers.description: Total Focus is complete mastery over Energy Melee. This melee attack is a very slow, but incredibly devastating attack that can knock out most opponents, leaving them Disoriented. Due to the exhausting nature of Total Focus, recharge time is very long. This power will enter Energy Focus mode.

powers.name: Power Crash
powers.description:
You focus your internal energy on your fists and release it once you hit your target unleashing an energy wave that hurts and disorients multiple enemies. This power will hit up to 5 additional foes if used while in Energy Focus mode.

Notes: Power Crash is unaffected by Arc changes.

powers.name: Energy Transfer
powers.description: Mastery of Energy Melee culminates with the ability to transfer your own Hit Points into a punch that deals extreme damage. Energy Transfer has a good chance of Disorienting the target. This power will execute extremely quickly if under Energy Focus mode.
powers.shortHelp: Melee, DMG(Energy), Foe Disorient, Self -HP, Special

formVariants.shortHelp: Melee, DMG(Energy), Foe Disorient, Self -HP, Special
formVariants.description:
Mastery of Energy Melee culminates with the ability to transfer your own Hit Points into a punch that deals extreme damage. Energy Transfer has a good chance of Disorienting the target. This power will execute extremely quickly if under Energy Focus mode.

Damage: Extreme.
Recharge: Moderate.
